name: vllm_ggml_moe_a8_vec
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_ggml_moe_a8_vec.py. GGML Q8_0 (quant_type=8) MoE vector/GEMV path via vLLM _custom_ops.ggml_moe_a8_vec. X (tokens, hidden) fp32 is plain random. W (num_experts, row, (hidden//32)*34) uint8 is a valid Q8_0 buffer built vectorized in gen_inputs (positive fp16 scale bytes + random int8 payload). topk_ids (tokens, top_k) int32 in [0,num_experts) is also built in gen_inputs. quant_type, row, tokens, top_k are scalars. Returns the fp32 output. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
